title: WindWand SMP
description: A survival mod package for WindWand Minecraft server
body:
# WindWand SMP This is a Modpack for WindWand SMP ## Information - Version: 1.21.7 - Total 87 mods, 115MB ## Known Issues - Shulker Preview Crash - **Description:** when you hover on shulker box your game crash - **Solution:** disable `Tweakeroo` shulker preview option, use `Shulker box tooltip` as replacement - **Report:** The mod `Masa Gadget` haven't update to 1.21.7 version so we are using `Masa Gaget Dev`, however this is still in beta verison with some bugs, so when ever Tweakeroo call shulker box display function your game crash. But you can use `Shulker box tooltip` as replacement for it. ## Include Mods
